answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume, no buffer, and only 14 days to expiry, switching primary vendor (memory_c2) or deferring (memory_c5) introduces unacceptable delivery risk; adding a second source cannot be executed in this window. The only path that pursues the 18% cost mandate without increasing delivery risk is renegotiating with the incumbent at renewal — memory_c4 shows benchmarking moved the incumbent on price and terms, and memory_c6 shows multi-year commitments unlocked volume pricing. However, memory_c4 was consolidated without a figure attached, and whether its recovered margin approaches 18% is unverified, so I am verifying it before committing. If the archived record shows the margin gain was modest, I will combine negotiation with a multi-year volume commitment (memory_c6) and treat the 18% target as partially achievable this cycle rather than forcing a risky switch.
